svg.text: PLATE 02A · SURVIVAL KNOWLEDGE · RETORT / CLAY VESSEL METHOD
— SEAL WOOD IN CLAY POT · EXTERNAL FIRE · OXYGEN RESTRICTED —
charcoal forms inside because oxygen cannot reach the wood
cut short — must fit inside pot
pack tightly · wood only — no soil, no wet leaves
leave ONE small vent hole — do not seal it
keep fire burning · smoke from vent = still working
seal the vent hole · do not open yet · let cool sealed
jet black · lightweight · metallic clink = good charcoal
